title: The Lantern of Vilna
author: Astrid Iversen
blurb: Vesper Dravenmoor, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
